method: Direct visual inspection of the ten returned PNG images listed below. This acceptance is independent of machine checks.

accepted.observation: Compact-card title and subtitle text remains legible. The conspicuous horizontal title-background band is gone; the continuous shade preserves visible architectural detail.
Mobile compact-card location aligns left while the CTA stays aligned right. No title/footer collisions observed.
The sole opening article now spans the full parent grid at tablet/desktop, with heading left and prose right; mobile retains a readable stacked flow. No clipping or text intersections observed.
The visible upper regions of related compact cards use the same smooth, legible shading with aligned card tops and no abrupt gradient band.
Enquiry headings, action buttons and the related-section heading remain separated and legible on mobile.

earlierAcceptedFindings.note: Team framing and tablet two-column layout were visually accepted in main R3; final content.css corrections target only project cards and lone opening stories.

limitations: The AVA/ORLA mobile detail images show only the top edge of related cards. They do not constitute a full mobile related-card inspection.
The related-card desktop images show card upper regions; complete compact-card geometry was inspected on the developments listing at the same component styles.
Only the ten listed PNGs were visually reviewed in this final pass. No claim is made that all 32 final states were manually inspected by this reviewer.
No browser, build or test suite was launched by this reviewer.
